purpose: run the right automated tests on every change in a pipeline that is fast, reliable and trusted
entry_criteria: Test suites exist at unit, integration and end-to-end levels
Test environments or containers can be created on demand
procedure: Order the stages so cheap, fast tests run first and fail early; run slow suites only when relevant paths change.
Run independent suites in parallel with isolated data and environments.
Publish test reports and logs as artifacts, with failing test names in the summary.
Track flaky tests with owner and expiry; quarantine rather than retry-until-green.
Set a time budget for the pipeline and alert when it is exceeded.
Make the test stage a required check on the default branch.
acceptance_criteria: Failures show which test failed and why
Flaky tests have owners and expiry dates
Pipeline duration is within the agreed budget
validation_method: Platform and security review plus a clean pipeline run from scratch.

validation.expect: recent runs succeed; durations within budget

validation.check: open a pull request with a deliberately failing test
validation.expect: merge is blocked and the report names the test

failure_modes.detection: Pass after rerun with no investigation
failure_modes.response: Quarantine with owner; fix root cause
Split suites, cache dependencies, run slow tests on a schedule

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Unit tests finish in two minutes and gate integration tests, which run in four parallel jobs. Two flaky end-to-end tests are quarantined with owners and a one-month expiry.
